decision: Use the residential-floor preview revision as the base
why: Main lacks the current viewer and backlog features

decision: Build and pin the upstream npm tarball on the server
why: The npm package is unpublished and must install without a local runtime
result: Built from upstream 9a9b327 and integrity pinned in lockfile

decision: Use one atomic script with an observe/propose/decline return
why: A script owns one draft and cannot select an implicit prior checkpoint
result: Two candidates compared and independent review preferred the atomic design

decision: Record full server-container and production-image results
why: Compilation alone does not prove proposal and rollback behavior
result: 328 tests passed with two existing skips; all 12 image integration tests passed

decision: Fix denied-call recovery and hostile-text audit gaps before publication
why: The independent reviews found paths not covered by the first passing suite
result: Two runtime regressions failed before the fix and passed afterward

decision: Require consistent terminal proposal evidence when restoring new reviews
why: A saved proposal must not claim success using only failed executions
result: Outcome and saved-review regressions failed before the fix; final suite passes

decision: Keep the shared preview unchanged and qualify a separate candidate
why: Security and persistence changes need maintainer review before release
result: Live ChatGPT office and room-local workflows passed; only disposable test data changed

decision: Publish a draft against the residential-floor feature branch
why: The implementation is verified but merge and shared-preview replacement require human review
result: Draft PR created; no issue closed and no auto-merge enabled
